column2: Copy the attributes from the parent group
Group "%s" has no parent group to copy from.
Parent group "%s" has no attribute declared.
Only the missing attributes are added; anything already declared on this group is left as it is.
Declare the specifications that every asset in this group has. Assets then show exactly these fields to fill in.
The fields here are decided by the asset group. Change the group and the set of fields changes with it — the old values are not lost, but they only reappear on returning to the right group.
\n Choose the asset group first — the set of\n specifications shown is decided by the group.

Declare here the specifications that every asset in this group has — a transformer, for example, needs primary and secondary voltage and a vector group. Adding a new field needs no programming.
Attributes do not flow down to child groups: inherit them implicitly and one edit changes the data of hundreds of assets with nobody seeing it. Use the button below to copy them deliberately.
